                automatically. Assigned to every owner at creation.
              type: string
              example: '3F9A1C2B4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:

                telephone, the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and the household id,

                detection itself keys off the household id (same last name and postcode).
              type: string

              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
